description: FileFast is a high-performance file sharing platform designed for users who need speed, reliability, and detailed insights. Unlike traditional services where files expire quickly or offer no visibility, FileFast allows you to share files up to 250GB while maintaining long-term control. It is specifically optimized for distribution across Discord, community forums, and social media platforms.
